verdict: Red 6/10 ACCEPT-WITH-CUTS, blue 7/10 PARTIALLY OVERTURNED - and this is the only name in the batch where BOTH benches end at a position rather than at FLAT, which is why it escalates rather than being settled here. Red's structure: zero pre-print position until the ~8/14 July operating data, a starter only if that data confirms run-rate, half the intended full size for reflexivity and the China tail, all adds after the 8/19 opex line. Blue adopted that structure and then ADDED a fallback red's cut lacks: if the July data lands by 8/17 confirming post-PDT options ADV at or above ~4.3M, take a one-third starter; if it does NOT land by 8/17, a one-quarter starter is still warranted on the June-data-versus-consensus-floor edge alone. Both benches verified the revenue reconstruction independently and both find it genuinely above the ~$178M consensus - blue lands it at $187-194M after shaving the interest leg. So the edge is real and twice-verified. The dispute is about whether it is the variable that pays. Red tagged FATAL on the claim that the market demonstrably does not trade this name on revenue: on 5/21 Webull printed +36% revenue and made new lows, because the axis was the GAAP loss ($21.7M), marketing (+115% to $49.4M) and SBC (+113%) - a line management refused to guide and stated intent to spend into, given the PDT rule change effective 6/4/26. Blue reduced that to SIZING on an internal-consistency attack that is correct and worth preserving: red's finding 1 asserts the tape already re-rated the 7/15 June data, and finding 3 asserts the market ignores revenue-side data - both cannot hold, and neither bench has bars to arbitrate because IBKR was permission-denied on both. One observation (5/21) cannot carry a FATAL tag. What both benches agree is dead is the DISLOCATION premise, and this is the finding with the most cross-name value: blue dated hi52 $17.08 to 2025-08-18, the decay tail of the de-SPAC squeeze (all-time high $62.90 on 2025-04-14), and then found the corollary red missed - that anchor rolls out of the 52-week window around 2026-08-18, one session BEFORE the print. The -50pp excess-drawdown event row that put BULL on this docket mechanically self-heals regardless of fundamentals. The screen fired on an evaporating anchor. Supply is verified and larger than briefed (147,445,012 Class A plus 6.79M private and 20M incentive warrants registered, including 20.75M from founder Anquan Wang's Class B) but is April-vintage and the stock rallied 61% through it, so it cannot explain an August discount - red conceded this honestly. Reflexivity is sustained and strengthened by blue: funded accounts have been flat at 5.1M for four months, so 100% of growth is per-account intensity levered to record system margin, and deposits are +7% YoY while margin balances are +110% - the interest book's growth is entirely the risk-levered leg, which is worse than red stated and argues for a rational multiple cap. Net: a real, small, verified revenue edge; a payoff variable (marketing) that is unobservable until 8/19; a dislocation premise that is half-artifact and self-expiring; and two benches recommending a fractional starter on different fallback rules. || SESSION RULING: ESCALATION RULED: on a July-data slip past 8/17, NO POSITION (red's branch) — the ~8/14 date is cadence-inferred not company-committed, and entering on an unconfirmed catalyst violates verify-catalyst-dates-from-primary. If data lands on time, both benches' starter branches proceed as drafted. The de-SPAC hi52 roll-out (~8/18 self-heal) means the screen row dies mechanically either way.
